summary: Restoration commitments report 444 million mu of afforestation completed in 2016–2019 and over 10,000 mangrove seedlings planted since 2015; an urban rule also requires photovoltaics or vegetation on at least 30% of new public-housing open space. Conservation targets include a 6 billion m³ increase in forest stock by 2030 from 2005 and 140 million hectares of natural forest by end-2019, equivalent to about 75.4% of current forest cover. Mixed ecosystem measures achieved over 8.3 million hectares of protection and restoration since 2016 (about 0.9% of land) and 56% natural-grassland vegetation coverage by 2019, in a land class covering 29.0% of the country, alongside a 3.15 million km² protection/restoration area (33.5% of land) and 50,000 hectares for ecosystem adaptation. Agriculture reached 68.3 million hectares of effectively irrigated farmland in 2019, about 26.5% of current agricultural area.
